IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman sits on a snowbank in a
brown fur-trimmed hat and a long charcoal wool
scarf. She wears a tan embroidered shawl over a
dark wool coat and holds white gloves in her lap.
Her face is turned to the side, with hair blowing
loose at her temple and a soft red lip. Bright winter
sun, a palette of charcoal, camel, cream, and icy
blue. Warm and adventurous, in the style of a
winter travel editorial.
